name: Welcome, Novice
summary: Every adventurer registers at the Adventurer's Guild. Find Seraphine at the guild hall south-east of the fountain.

objectives.label: Register with Seraphine at the Guild

offer: A new face! You must have just arrived in Willowbrook.
Before anything else, register at the Adventurer's Guild. Seraphine runs it, south-east of the plaza.
progress: The guild hall is south-east of the fountain. Look for the crest sign.
complete: Registered and ready. Welcome to the Guild, Novice!
I'll teach you the basics: hunting, gearing up and refining. Let's start with hunting.

name: Training: First Hunt
summary: Head east into Sunny Meadow and defeat Leaf Slimes. Click a monster to attack it; potions are on hotbar key 1.

offer: Monsters give experience and drop materials you can sell.
Sunny Meadow is through the east gate. Defeat five Leaf Slimes and come back.
progress: Click a slime to attack. If your HP gets low, drink a potion (key 1) or step back.
complete: Your fists won't carry you far, though. Time to get a proper weapon.

name: Training: Arm Yourself
summary: Buy a weapon from Garrick's smithy and equip it (double-click it in your inventory or drag it to the Equip window).

objectives.label: Buy a weapon at Garrick's smithy

offer: Garrick the blacksmith sells starter weapons north of the plaza.
Novices can use daggers and clubs. Buy one and equip it, then show Garrick.
progress: Buy a weapon from Garrick, then equip it from your inventory (I).
complete: Good steel suits you. Here, three Starsteel Ores, on the house.
Ores are what I use to refine weapons. Want to learn how?

name: Training: The Refiner's Art
summary: Ask Garrick to refine a piece of equipment to +1. Weapons use Starsteel Ore, armor uses Moonstone Ore. Refines up to +5 (weapons) and +4 (armor) never fail.

offer: Refining hardens a weapon or armor and raises its power.
Up to +5 on weapons and +4 on armor it's safe. Beyond that, a failed attempt destroys the item, so be careful!
Pick 'Refine equipment' and bring me to +1.
progress: Choose 'Refine equipment' when you talk to me. You need one ore and a small fee.
complete: Keep refining safely to +5. Past that, it's a gamble.

name: Training: Choosing a Path
summary: Reach Job Level 10 as a Novice. Then visit a class guild master: Knight in Aurelion, Ranger in Fernhollow, Mage in Arcanthe.

offer: You've learned the basics. Now grow strong: reach Job Level 10.
Then choose a class. Knights train in the capital Aurelion, Rangers in Fernhollow, Mages in the tower city Arcanthe.
progress: Job experience comes from monsters. Sunny Meadow and the forest are good hunting grounds.
complete: Job Level 10! Your training is complete.
Take these, and go find your guild. The world is yours to explore.
